limits: Static opcode/source/typed-input review only. No static CFG is promoted to executed proof; no fresh guest or device operation by reviewer.
Symbol-sized opcode rows skip ELF $d pools and are bounded instruction listings, not exhaustive recursive CFG.
Parser submitted_frames/submitted_pcm_bytes count speculative successful frames before whole-packet publication; these counters are not FIFO commit or audible output evidence.
Code remains single serialized Source producer/single mixer consumer, storage pinned. No full Bluetooth receive registration/event loop, fragmentation/reorder/jitter handling or native exclusivity.
Compiled command handlers discard some send_mixer returns; actual message insertion/full native returns must be checked in bounded runtime; this is not a robust production command API.
No complete player image, App/UI/install/VPM/SIG acceptance, physical speaker/hardware, native allocator, STOP_DONE, exclusive ownership or safe unload is established.
